limitations: Existence for the specified family in three complex variables only; no classification in dimension two.

Unindexed equivalent literature remains a possibility.
scientific_integrity: One uniform analytic theorem with complete inequalities, algebraic irreducibility, and standard Hopf-fibration topology. The accessible primary text was compared on its hypotheses and implications. Same-model review only; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Irreducible ball-stable polynomials with arbitrarily many Hopf-linked boundary circles
